# Snapshot identity

TripleTeam vendors the Pi packages it uses from upstream commit `7f06f9cf1626504cde95683f1c81a72a7bc7a0cb`, package version `0.86.1`, copied on 2026-09-22.

This is a fixed copy, not a submodule and not an automatic upstream mirror. The TypeScript source and official release build are colocated in each package directory.
